name: Evox Technology (Pvt) Ltd
description: Evox Technology is a premier software development company delivering innovative digital solutions to businesses worldwide. We specialize in web applications, mobile apps, cloud infrastructure, and AI-driven systems.
about: Founded in 2024, Evox Technology has grown from a small startup into a trusted technology partner for businesses across the globe. We believe great software is built on three pillars: technical excellence, deep understanding of our clients' needs, and a relentless focus on quality. Our team of 50+ engineers, designers, and project managers work collaboratively to deliver solutions that drive real business outcomes.
mission: To empower businesses with transformative technology solutions that drive growth, efficiency, and innovation.
vision: To be the most trusted technology partner for businesses seeking digital transformation in South Asia and beyond.
registration: Registered under Companies Act No. 07 of 2007
